hudson-blue.$description: Hudson Blue — Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate-cyan.$description: Slate Cyan — Blue accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite-night.$description: Graphite Night — Floating navigation island fill and icon strokes — the dark surface that anchors the pill-shaped nav against the light canvas

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text and dominant border color. Drives 619 occurrences — the structural backbone of the interface

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary heading text and dark UI elements — slightly softer than Ink for subheadings and dense text blocks

iron.$description: Iron — Button borders, icon strokes, mid-dark surface edges. Sits between Ink and Steel on the dark scale

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text and link borders. The first step down from primary text — used for body captions and less-prominent metadata

fog.$description: Fog — Light hairlines and faint surface fills — gentle dividers that separate content without drawing attention

ash.$description: Ash — Mid-gray for subtle background fills and muted borders on inactive elements

mist.$description: Mist — Soft fill for inactive or decorative surface layers — the lightest non-white tone before borders kick in

sage.$description: Sage — Card and button border ring — the barely-there outline that gives surfaces their edge in lieu of shadow

cream.$description: Cream — Page canvas — a warm off-white that prevents the site from feeling clinical. The single most prominent background

linen.$description: Linen — Secondary surface and nav fill — one step cooler than Cream, used for floating panels and alternating bands

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, elevated panels, and the topmost layer in the surface stack. Pure white for content blocks floating above the Cream canvas

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

ppmondwest.$description: Display headings — the editorial serif that gives the brand its literary, almost academic register. Used at 40-54px with tight -0.02em tracking. The 'liga' 0 feature setting deliberately disables ligatures, preserving the spaced, slightly geometric character of each letterform.

af.$description: Body text, UI elements, navigation, buttons, and inline links. The functional workhorse — compact, quiet, and highly legible. Light negative tracking (-0.01 to -0.012em) tightens dense UI text without feeling stylized.
